messages.content: I forgot all the API tokens, can you remind me of them? My user ID is 12345.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of all shareable API tokens associated with the user's account. These tokens can be used to grant access to custom dashboards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Creates a new API token which can be used for authentication and access to the API endpoints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the API token is being created.

permissions.description: The access level of the API token. Possible values are 'read' for read-only access, 'write' for write access, and 'admin' for full administrative privileges.

expiration_date.description: The expiration date of the API token, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not specified, defaults to 'null', which represents no expiration date.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of all API tokens associated with the user account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose API tokens are to be retrieved.

include_expired.description: Flag to include expired tokens in the list.

message.reasoning:
The user wants their existing API tokens. We have a tool `api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens` that retrieves all API tokens for a given user id. We'll call it.

We need to pass user_id=12345. No other parameters needed; we want all tokens (including expired or not). By default include_expired=false but maybe they want all tokens including expired ones. They didn't specify so let's just retrieve without specifying include_expired. That will return non-expired tokens only. But if they might want all tokens, we could set include_expired=true. Let's ask clarifying question first. However guidelines say we should respond directly unless ambiguous. It's somewhat ambiguous whether they want all tokens or just active ones. I'd interpret "forgot all the API tokens" meaning they'd like to see all tokens regardless of status. So I'll request include_expired=true. Then provide result.
